newsitem.title: USA: CMS finds oil in Venezuela's Campo Rosario.
newsitem.headline: CMS finds oil in Venezuela's Campo Rosario.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said its oil and gas exploration unit CMS NOMECO Oil & Gas Co completed the Campo Rosario well 13 in the Colon Block of the Maracaibo basin in western Venezuela.

It said that The development well was completed from 7,680 to 7,800 feet in the Mirador formation, for an initial production rate of 4,200 barrels of oil per day and the company is now drilling an offset well.
The block is operated by Tecpetrol de Venezuela SA, and other partners are CMS, with 29 percebt, Coparex Latina de Petrolcos S.A.; and Wascana de Venezuela.
The block is currently producing 9,200 barrels of oil per day and production is expected to increase to at least 15,000 barrels per day by early next year.
